title: backend-skeleton scanner adapter descriptor
description: Validates the JSON-shaped fields of the `adapter` object a scanners/adapters/<id>.mjs module must export (detect/scan/diagnostics/listReadSet are functions and are checked separately -- JSON Schema has no vocabulary for them). Loaded by scanners/registry.mjs at process start. See D-adapter-registry in DECISIONS.md.

verificationBasis.description: D-adapter-verification-basis (W2/B6): a DIFFERENT axis from `confidence` above -- confidence means "how sure was detect() this repo uses this framework," verificationBasis means "how well was this adapter's own parsing/codegen logic checked against real code, ever." official-reference: verified against a framework-author-maintained reference stack. production-repo: verified against a real production repo. community-sample: verified against one hand-read community boilerplate, no official reference exists. synthetic-only: no real-world oracle at all, only a committed synthetic fixture. not-applicable: reconnaissance-only, no codegen to verify (generic-grep).
